claim: The Resource Groups Tagging API GetResources, GetTagKeys and GetTagValues operations support all resource types.
question: Does the Resource Groups Tagging API GetResources operation return Amazon GuardDuty detectors, so that a command can filter detectors by tag?

qualifiers.scope: Resource Groups Tagging API read operations; the same page lists Amazon GuardDuty among the services that work with the API and names IAM users and roles and Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups as exceptions for GetResources

note: requests-09 for fr-0032 (task detection-t02 verify step). The Welcome page lists Amazon GuardDuty and names no GuardDuty exception for GetResources (the exceptions it names are IAM users and roles, and EC2 Auto Scaling groups). The Resource Groups resource-type table also marks AWS::GuardDuty::Detector as Yes for tag-based groups.
